note: Literature explicitly documents structural central nervous system and brain malformations in patients with pathogenic bi-allelic variants in FILIP1.

evidence.text: Roos et al. describe five patients with homozygous FILIP1 variants exhibiting neurological symptoms including brain malformations (such as semilobar holoprosencephaly or periventricular anomalies), neurodevelopmental delay, and muscle pathology.

source.title: Bi-allelic variants of FILIP1 cause congenital myopathy, dysmorphism and neurological defects
source.quote: Patients exhibit a broad spectrum of neurological symptoms including brain malformations, neurodevelopmental delay, muscle weakness and pathology and dysmorphic features.

evidence.text: A comprehensive review notes that FILIP1 loss-of-function variants have been identified as a cause of arthrogryposis multiplex congenita, characterized by fetal onset with profound brain malformations and severe ocular anomalies.

source.title: Arthrogryposis Multiplex Congenita: Comprehensive Review from a Neuromuscular Standpoint
